verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature docs describe breaking work into actionable tasks and assigning them to the right person. Community users describe assigning tickets to teammates such as QA, with the limitation that a ticket can only have one assignee. Due dates are only implied by the timeline and calendar views, never explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of due-date fields on tasks, detailed first-party docs on manual task creation and assignment, and support for multiple assignees.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create tasks and assign them to teammates with due dates
